reasons.plausibility: Adding microalloying elements to strengthen lamellar colony interfaces and reduce microcracking is scientifically sound but has some uncertainties about the exact segregation and phase formation.
reasons.testability: The proposed comparison of baseline and doped samples under the same processing, followed by microstructural and mechanical testing, provides a clear and decisive experiment to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Targeted boundary strengthening through microalloying is directly relevant to the goal of improving both strength and ductility in eutectic high-entropy alloys.
